theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by 
  classical
  have h₁ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra h
    have hA : A ∉ P := by simpa using h.1
    have hAc : Aᶜ ∉ P := by simpa using h.2
    have : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
      by_contra hA_not
      push_neg at hA_not
      have hA_full : ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by
        intro U hU
        have hU_ne : A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := by simpa using hA_not U hU
        exact hU_ne
      exact hPS ⟨A, hA, hA_full⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hU_eq⟩ := this
    have : ∃ V ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ V = ∅ := by
      by_contra hAc_not
      push_neg at hAc_not
      have hAc_full : ∀ V ∈ P, Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := by
        intro V hV
        have hV_ne : Aᶜ ∩ V ≠ ∅ := by simpa using hAc_not V hV
        exact hV_ne
      exact hPS ⟨Aᶜ, hAc, hAc_full⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hV_eq⟩ := this
    have hUV : U ∩ V = ∅ := by
      rw [hV_eq]
      simp
    exact hPP U hU V hV |>.symm ▸ hUV
  have h₂ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    simpa using this
  have h₃ : (Finset.univ \\ P).card = P.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA; exact h₂ A hA
    · intro A hA; exact h₁ A |>.resolve_left (fun h => hA h)
    · intro A hA; exact h₂ A hA
    · intro A hA; exact h₁ A |>.resolve_left (fun h => hA h)
    · simp
    · simp
  have h₄ : 2 * P.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
    have h₅ : P.card + (Finset.univ \\ P).card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [Finset.card_union_add_card_inter]
      · simp
      · simp
      · simp
    rw [h₃] at h₅
    linarith
  have h₅ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  rw [h₅] at h₄
  have h₆ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    intro h
    have : S = ∅ := by
      apply Fintype.card_eq_zero'.mp
      simpa using h
    exact Nonempty.ne_empty this
  have h₇ : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    rw [h₄]
    rw [h₅]
    omega
  exact h₇
